label: Высокий / Низкий
description: Height and level contrasts for trees, shelves, ceilings, and people.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: A classic tall-object image. 1. 'Высокое' matches the neuter noun here through the form pattern. 2. 'Дерево' gives a very clear visual target. 3. This is one of the easiest high-value examples.

Strategic focus: Low object description. 1. 'Низкий' matches the masculine noun 'стол'. 2. The image is simple and everyday. 3. This is good for teaching how English 'low' becomes Russian adjective agreement.
Strategic focus: Shelf height. 1. 'Высокая' matches the feminine noun 'полка'. 2. The sentence is practical for home and kitchen contexts. 3. It reinforces one adjective across multiple noun genders.
Strategic focus: Spatial environment. 1. 'Низкий' makes the ceiling feel physically close. 2. 'Потолок' is a highly concrete noun. 3. This is useful for describing rooms and places.
Strategic focus: Two linked contrasts. 1. 'Высокий' and 'низкий' give an immediate height opposition. 2. The two nouns are easy to picture. 3. This sentence is a strong future drill template.
